Books & Edited Volumes

Themistocleous, C. (2015). Experimental Design and Statistics in Linguistics: Using R (In Greek). Athens: Ion Publishing. ISBN: 978-960-508-187-4.

Comprehensive monograph introducing experimental methodology, hypothesis formulation, linear and mixed-effects modeling, and statistical analysis for linguistics and speech sciences using R.
